explication: Monolog is a PSR-3 PHP logging library. Applications submit levelled messages to Logger, which creates LogRecord values, applies processors, and dispatches records through configured handlers. Handlers may filter, buffer, format, rotate, or deliver records to files, sockets, databases, inboxes, consoles, and web services. ErrorHandler and SignalHandler adapt PHP runtime failures into log calls. The tree and README establish broad handler coverage; sampled source confirms representative Elasticsearch, Telegram, socket, rotating-file, processor, and console paths.
